Beyond that, there was an area roughly 100ft wide where all buildings had been razed, the rubble removed and replaced by regularly raked soil (so that footprints could be easily seen). This area was filled with electrified barbed wire fences, tank traps, guard towers, caltrops (spike mats) and patrol routes for guards and guard dogs. That part was called the death strip, it's where most people died trying to escape.

Beyond that was the Berlin wall proper, and then a few meters of east germany before you finally crossed the border. There needed to be a strip of east germany on the other side of the wall so that the guards could exit via hatches to inspect the far side of the wall, naturally, only the most trusted were permitted to do so.
